name: degoog
description: degoog is a search aggregator that queries multiple engines and shows results in one place. You can add custom search engines, bang-command plugins, slot plugins (query-triggered panels above/below results or in the sidebar), and transports (custom HTTP fetch strategies like curl, FlareSolverr, or your own).

paths.name: Appdata: data
paths.description: Holds plugins, themes, engines, transports, plugin settings and aliases.

ports.name: PORT
ports.description: You can change 4444 to any available port on your host system. Must match DEGOOG_PORT.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Process User ID that the container will run as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Process Group ID that the container will run as.

variables.name: Degoog Port
variables.description: Port the server listens on inside the container. Must match the host port mapping above.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Optional. Base path for serving Degoog behind a reverse proxy at a sub-path (e.g. /degoog). A full URL is also accepted — only the path portion is used. Leave empty to serve at the root /.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Controls the verbosity of server-side console output. Supported levels from most to least severe: fatal, error, warn, info, log, debug. Each level includes all levels of higher severity. Set to debug to print all messages, including plugin execution times.

variables.name: Log Translation
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to enable translation-specific log output. This is a separate toggle from LOG_LEVEL and is off by default. Useful when debugging missing keys, locale resolution misses, or broken locale files.

variables.name: Settings Passwords
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of passwords for the Settings page. If set, users must enter one of these to access Settings (unless a middleware plugin is used as the settings gate).

variables.name: Settings Path
variables.description: Optional. Custom path for the admin settings panel. Defaults to /admin on public instances and /settings on private ones. Set to a hard-to-guess string to make the panel undiscoverable (e.g. my-secret-panel-abc123). Leading slashes are stripped automatically. Note: on public instances this path only works if DEGOOG_SETTINGS_PASSWORDS is also set.

variables.name: Public Instance
variables.description: Optional. When set to a truthy value (e.g. true, 1), the instance runs in read-only mode: settings show only theme and engine toggles, no tabs; all server-side mutation APIs return Unauthorized.

variables.name: Distrust Proxy
variables.description: Optional. Controls whether Degoog trusts X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP and X-Forwarded-Proto headers for client IP, rate limiting, IP banning and HTTPS detection. Defaults to 1 (distrust), which is the safe choice when Degoog is exposed directly to the internet, since trusting these headers lets any client spoof their source IP and protocol. Set to 0 only when Degoog sits behind a reverse proxy (nginx, caddy, traefik, etc.) that you control and that strips or rewrites these headers on incoming requests.

variables.name: Default Search Language
variables.description: Default ISO 639-1 language code applied to all searches when no language is selected by the user (e.g. en, de, it).

variables.name: UI Locale (i18n)
variables.description: Optional. Forces the UI locale for all requests, overriding the Accept-Language header (e.g. en-US, fr-FR). Unset or empty: Accept-Language is used.

variables.name: Plugins Dir
variables.description: Optional. Directory to load custom command and slot plugins from.

variables.name: Themes Dir
variables.description: Optional. Directory to load custom themes from.

variables.name: Engines Dir
variables.description: Optional. Directory to load custom search engine plugins from.

variables.name: Transports Dir
variables.description: Optional. Directory to load custom transports from.

variables.name: Autocomplete Dir
variables.description: Optional. Directory to load custom autocomplete from.

variables.name: Plugin Settings File
variables.description: Optional. Path to the JSON file storing extension settings (plugins, themes, engines, etc.).

variables.name: Default Engines File
variables.description: Optional. Path to the JSON file storing default enabled/disabled engines.

variables.name: Blocklist File
variables.description: Optional. Path to the JSON file storing the IP addresses blocklist.

variables.name: Settings Tokens File
variables.description: Optional. Path to the JSON file storing settings tokens.

variables.name: Aliases File
variables.description: Optional. Path to the JSON file defining custom bang command aliases.
